title: Tag an idea from a System 1 answer
description: The idea map tags an idea with a department or record when the System 1 answer's score is at or above the line.

question.text: Does this idea bear on this department or record?

evidence.sensor: the System 1 answers the idea map reads (Noul through Jev, or the founder's agent's answers file)

sources.note: The tags on the venture's idea map

scale.meaning: The answer's score for the tag, 0 to 1

note: The same number as threshold in packages/naive/src/functions/strategy/frameworks/idea-map/conventions.json. naive.config.json thresholds.idea-map still takes precedence over this line.
